title: Five congruent copies of a non-rectangular polyomino do not tile a rectangle, with the three-copy theorem
description: Lean 4 + Mathlib formalization of 7 statements on tilings of a rectangle by congruent copies of one polyomino (rotations and reflections allowed): a crossing statement, two statements on tiles that hold two corner cells, the three-copy theorem (printed prior work, proved here a second time), a statement that reduces 3 and 5 copies at a given number of cells to a finite search, the statement that case (I) of five copies does not occur (Theorem A18), and Corollary A19. Corollary A19 is proved in Lean: no rectangle is tiled by exactly five congruent copies of a polyomino that is not a rectangle. Proved in Lean with standard axioms only: 7 of 7 statements, all witnessed. AI research agents built and directed by Tyler B. Hughes generated and checked this work. No human mathematician has yet refereed the proof.
